Returns webhook event: `call.playback.ended` (for audio playback) or `call.speak.ended` (for text-to-speech playback) indicating playback has stopped. Side effects include: queued audio is not automatically resumed; subsequent playback commands must be issued to continue audio.
data.reasoning: Summary is clear and actionable. Description is too minimal and doesn't explain what happens to queued audio, which webhook is returned in which scenario, or side effects of stopping playback. The 'or' in the webhook description is ambiguous. Enhanced description clarifies immediate halt behavior, explains both webhook types, indicates queued audio behavior, and specifies that new commands are needed to resume playback.

Queued audio files are discarded and will not play after this operation.

Enhanced version clarifies both audio and speech stopping, explains queue clearing behavior, indicates call remains active, and clarifies webhook conditions for AI agent decision-making.
